svg.title: IoTextra Analog3 overview
svg.desc: IoTextra Analog3 — 8-channel differential analog input module overview with key specs
svg.text: 8-channel differential analog input module · 12-bit SAR ADC (ADS7828) · up to 50 kSPS · I²C only
Voltage 0–5V · Current 0–20mA / 4–20mA · HOST and Qwiic connectors · 47×56 mm · 5 VDC supply
Part of the IoTextra series · compatible with IoTsmart and IoTbase · Open Hardware
